title: Meta-analysis: BCG vaccine
description: Fixed and random effects pooling of metafor's dat.bcg (13 BCG vaccine trials, Colditz et al. 1994), in R: forest and funnel plots, heterogeneity (I2, tau2), meta-regression on absolute latitude, leave-one-out and a choice of estimators. The pooled estimates are checked by hand-written inverse-variance weighting and DerSimonian-Laird in the test.

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(metafor))

# dat.bcg: 13 trials of the BCG vaccine against tuberculosis (Colditz et al. 1994).
main <- function(ctx) {
  d <- escalc(measure = "RR", ai = tpos, bi = tneg, ci = cpos, di = cneg, data = dat.bcg)
  d <- as.data.frame(d)
  d$yi <- as.numeric(d$yi)
  d$vi <- as.numeric(d$vi)
  file <- file.path(ctx$output_directory, "bcg.csv")
  write.csv(d, file, row.names = FALSE)
  ctx$output("trials", list(value = file))
  ctx$display_table(data.frame(
    試験 = d$trial, 著者 = d$author, 年 = d$year,
    接種群 = sprintf("%d / %s", d$tpos, format(d$tpos + d$tneg, trim = TRUE)),
    対照群 = sprintf("%d / %s", d$cpos, format(d$cpos + d$cneg, trim = TRUE)),
    緯度 = d$ablat, RR = sprintf("%.2f", exp(d$yi)), `log RR` = sprintf("%.3f", d$yi), 分散 = sprintf("%.4f", d$vi),
    check.names = FALSE))
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(metafor))

# Fixed and random effects pooling, and the forest plot with both diamonds.
main <- function(ctx) {
  method <- ctx$params$method
  excluded <- unlist(ctx$params$exclude)
  d <- read.csv(ctx$path("trials"))
  d <- d[!d$trial %in% excluded, ]
  fixed <- rma(yi, vi, data = d, method = "EE")
  random <- rma(yi, vi, data = d, method = method)
  rows <- rbind(
    data.frame(model = "fixed", method = "EE", k = fixed$k, estimate = as.numeric(coef(fixed)), se = fixed$se,
               rr = exp(as.numeric(coef(fixed))), lower = exp(fixed$ci.lb), upper = exp(fixed$ci.ub), tau2 = 0, I2 = fixed$I2, Q = fixed$QE),
    data.frame(model = "random", method = method, k = random$k, estimate = as.numeric(coef(random)), se = random$se,
               rr = exp(as.numeric(coef(random))), lower = exp(random$ci.lb), upper = exp(random$ci.ub), tau2 = random$tau2, I2 = random$I2, Q = random$QE))
  file <- file.path(ctx$output_directory, "pooled.csv")
  write.csv(rows, file, row.names = FALSE)
  ctx$output("pooled", list(value = file))
  print(rows)

  labels <- sprintf("%s, %d", d$author, d$year)
  k <- nrow(d)
  ctx$plot({
    par(mar = c(4, 0, 2.6, 0), cex = 0.95)
    forest(random, slab = labels, atransf = exp, at = log(c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4)), xlim = c(-7.2, 4.4), alim = log(c(0.1, 4)),
           ylim = c(-2.5, k + 3), addfit = FALSE, xlab = "リスク比 (対数軸)",
           header = c("試験", "RR [95% CI]"))
    addpoly(fixed, row = -1, mlab = "固定効果 (EE)", atransf = exp)
    addpoly(random, row = -2, mlab = sprintf("変量効果 (%s)", method), atransf = exp)
    abline(h = 0)
    title(sprintf("BCG ワクチン %d 試験: I² = %.1f%%, τ² = %.3f, Q = %.1f", k, random$I2, random$tau2, random$QE), font.main = 1)
  }, alt = sprintf("Forest plot with fixed %.3f and random %.3f pooled risk ratios", rows$rr[1], rows$rr[2]), width = 8.5, height = 5.6)
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(metafor))

# Funnel plot, Egger-type regression and trim and fill.
main <- function(ctx) {
  d <- read.csv(ctx$path("trials"))
  model <- rma(yi, vi, data = d, method = ctx$params$method)
  egger <- regtest(model)
  filled <- trimfill(model)
  message(sprintf("regtest z %.3f p %.3f; trim and fill adds %d, RR %.3f", egger$zval, egger$pval, filled$k0, exp(as.numeric(coef(filled)))))
  ctx$plot({
    par(mar = c(4.4, 4.4, 3.4, 1))
    funnel(model, atransf = exp, at = log(c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4)), xlab = "リスク比 (対数軸)", ylab = "標準誤差", pch = 19, back = "grey95", shade = "grey95")
    title(sprintf("I² = %.1f%%, τ² = %.3f\n回帰検定 p = %.2f, trim and fill で補う試験 %d 件", model$I2, model$tau2, egger$pval, filled$k0), font.main = 1, cex.main = 1)
  }, alt = sprintf("Funnel plot, regression test p %.2f", egger$pval), width = 6.4, height = 5)
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(metafor))
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# Meta-regression: does the effect change with the moderator?
main <- function(ctx) {
  name <- ctx$params$moderator
  method <- ctx$params$method
  d <- read.csv(ctx$path("trials"))
  d$x <- d[[name]]
  overall <- rma(yi, vi, data = d, method = method)
  m <- rma(yi, vi, mods = ~ x, data = d, method = method)
  rows <- data.frame(moderator = name, method = method, intercept = coef(m)[1], slope = coef(m)[2], slope_se = m$se[2],
                     QM = m$QM, QM_p = m$QMp, tau2 = m$tau2, tau2_without = overall$tau2, R2 = m$R2, I2 = m$I2)
  file <- file.path(ctx$output_directory, "regression.csv")
  write.csv(rows, file, row.names = FALSE)
  ctx$output("regression", list(value = file))
  print(rows)

  grid <- seq(min(d$x), max(d$x), length.out = 100)
  band <- as.data.frame(predict(m, newmods = grid))
  band$x <- grid
  d$weight <- weights(m)
  figure <- ggplot(d, aes(x, yi)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_ribbon(data = band, aes(x, ymin = ci.lb, ymax = ci.ub), inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_line(data = band, aes(x, pred), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "#0072B2", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(aes(size = weight), colour = "#D55E00", alpha = 0.75, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = trial), size = 3.4, colour = "grey20", box.padding = 0.55, seed = 1, min.segment.length = Inf) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 9) +
    scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = sec_axis(transform = exp, name = "リスク比", breaks = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2))) +
    labs(x = if (name == "ablat") "試験地の緯度の絶対値 (度)" else name, y = "log リスク比",
         title = sprintf("傾き %.4f (p = %.2g)。τ² は %.3f → %.3f、説明された割合 R² = %.0f%%", m$b[2], m$pval[2], overall$tau2, m$tau2, m$R2),
         subtitle = "点の大きさは重み、数字は試験番号、帯は 95% 信頼区間") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
  ctx$plot(print(figure), alt = sprintf("Meta-regression on %s, slope %.4f", name, m$b[2]), width = 7.5, height = 5)
}

files.text:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(metafor))
library(ggplot2)

# What moves the pooled estimate: dropping one trial, or changing the tau^2 estimator.
main <- function(ctx) {
  d <- read.csv(ctx$path("trials"))
  methods <- ctx$params$estimators
  fit <- function(x, method) {
    m <- rma(yi, vi, data = x, method = method)
    data.frame(rr = exp(as.numeric(coef(m))), lower = exp(m$ci.lb), upper = exp(m$ci.ub), tau2 = m$tau2, I2 = m$I2)
  }
  loo <- function(method, label) do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i)
    cbind(panel = label, name = sprintf("%2d %s", d$trial[i], d$author[i]), left_out = d$trial[i], fit(d[-i, ], method))))
  leave <- rbind(loo("EE", "1 試験を除く: 固定効果"), loo("DL", "1 試験を除く: 変量効果 DL"))
  estimators <- do.call(rbind, lapply(methods, function(k) cbind(panel = "推定量を変える (全試験)", name = k, left_out = NA, fit(d, k))))
  rows <- rbind(leave, estimators)
  file <- file.path(ctx$output_directory, "sensitivity.csv")
  write.csv(rows, file, row.names = FALSE)
  ctx$output("sensitivity", list(value = file))

  full <- data.frame(panel = c("1 試験を除く: 固定効果", "1 試験を除く: 変量効果 DL"), rr = c(fit(d, "EE")$rr, fit(d, "DL")$rr))
  span <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f〜%.2f", min(x$rr), max(x$rr))
  names_order <- c(rev(unique(leave$name)), rev(methods))
  rows$name <- factor(rows$name, levels = names_order)
  rows$panel <- factor(rows$panel, levels = c(full$panel, "推定量を変える (全試験)"))
  figure <- ggplot(rows, aes(rr, name)) +
    geom_vline(data = full, aes(xintercept = rr), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), width = 0, orientation = "y", colour = "#0072B2", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(colour = "#0072B2", size = 1.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.4, 0.5, 0.7, 1)) +
    labs(x = "併合リスク比 (対数軸、横線は 95% 信頼区間、破線は全試験の値)", y = NULL,
         title = sprintf("併合リスク比の動く幅: 除外 (固定効果) %s, 除外 (変量効果) %s, 推定量 %s",
                         span(leave[leave$panel == full$panel[1], ]), span(leave[leave$panel == full$panel[2], ]), span(estimators))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  ctx$plot(print(figure), alt = "Leave-one-out and estimator comparison of the pooled risk ratio", width = 10, height = 4.8)
}

notes.html:
メタ解析: BCG ワクチンと結核

データは metafor 同梱の dat.bcg。結核に対する BCG ワクチンの 13 の臨床試験の実データです（Colditz et al., JAMA 1994;271:698–702）。

各試験のリスク比の対数 yiy_i とその分散 viv_i を、重み wiw_i で併合します。

μ^=∑iwiyi∑iwi,wi=1vi+τ2\hat\mu=\frac{\sum_i w_i y_i}{\sum_i w_i},\qquad w_i=\frac{1}{v_i+\tau^2}

τ2=0\tau^2=0 が固定効果、試験間の異質性 τ2>0\tau^2>0 を見込むのが変量効果です。I2I^2 は全体のばらつきのうち試験間の違いが占める割合です。

moderator が既知の説明、試験地の緯度に対するメタ回帰です（赤道から離れるほど効果が大きい）。ただしこれは試験を単位とした観察的な関連で、緯度そのものが原因とは言えません。

pool の method（DL, REML, ...）と exclude（除く試験番号）を変えて、その Card だけを実行し直せます。sensitivity は 1 試験を除いたときと推定量を変えたときの変化を並べます。

昔の試験の統計手法の例であり、接種についての助言ではありません。
